an10.237:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an10.237:1.3: Asubhasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā pahānasaññā virāgasaññā nirodhasaññā.
an10.237:1.4: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā. 3.
